8fcb27f05db49a24de3e5ed18272b012f1de63b7.why: Counter-anchoring retrieval rationale to evaluate the relationship between bilateral inferior lens dislocation and tall stature with arachnodactyly in the context of Marfan syndrome and other genetic disorders.

evidence_chain.link: Marfan syndrome is characterized by ectopia lentis, which is a subluxation or dislocation of the lens.
Ehlers-Danlos syndrome is associated with joint hypermobility and skin hyperextensibility, and can also involve ocular features such as ectopia lentis.

ranked_facts.why: The presence of bilateral inferior lens dislocation is a key feature of both Marfan syndrome and Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, which are represented by candidates B1 and B2, respectively.
